paragraphs.text: translated by
1. HE hath arrived, he whom we sought with longing, who skilled in sacrifice well knows its courses.
paragraphs.original: यमैच्छाम मनसा सोऽयमागाद्यज्ञस्य विद्वान्परुषश्चिकित्वान् ।
paragraphs.translit: yamaicchāma manasā so'yamāgādyajñasya vidvānparuṣaścikitvān |

paragraphs.text: Let him discharge his sacrificial duties: let him sit down as Friend who was before Us.
paragraphs.original: स नो यक्षद्देवताता यजीयान्नि हि षत्सदन्तरः पूर्वो अस्मत्
paragraphs.translit: sa no yakṣaddevatātā yajīyānni hi ṣatsadantaraḥ pūrvo asmat

paragraphs.text: 2. Best Priest, he hath been won by being seated, for he hath looked on the well-ordered viands.
paragraphs.original: अराधि होता निषदा यजीयानभि प्रयांसि सुधितानि हि ख्यत् ।
paragraphs.translit: arādhi hotā niṣadā yajīyānabhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni hi khyat |

paragraphs.text: Come, let us worship Gods who must be worshipped, and pouring oil, laud those who should be lauded.
paragraphs.original: यजामहै यज्ञियान्हन्त देवाँ ईळामहा ईड्याँ आज्येन
paragraphs.translit: yajāmahai yajñiyānhanta devām̐ īḷāmahā īḍyām̐ ājyena

paragraphs.text: 3. Now hath he made the feast of Gods effective: now have we found the secret tongue of worship.
paragraphs.original: साध्वीमकर्देववीतिं नो अद्य यज्ञस्य जिह्वामविदाम गुह्याम् ।
paragraphs.translit: sādhvīmakardevavītiṃ no adya yajñasya jihvāmavidāma guhyām |

paragraphs.text: Now hath he come, sweet, robed in vital vigour, and made our calling on the Gods effective.
paragraphs.original: स आयुरागात्सुरभिर्वसानो भद्रामकर्देवहूतिं नो अद्य
paragraphs.translit: sa āyurāgātsurabhirvasāno bhadrāmakardevahūtiṃ no adya

paragraphs.text: 4. This prelude of my speech I now will utter, whereby we Gods may quell our Asura foemen.
paragraphs.original: तदद्य वाचः प्रथमं मसीय येनासुराँ अभि देवा असाम ।
paragraphs.translit: tadadya vācaḥ prathamaṃ masīya yenāsurām̐ abhi devā asāma |

paragraphs.text: Eaters of strengthening food who merit worship, O ye Five Tribes, be pleased with mine oblation.
paragraphs.original: ऊर्जाद उत यज्ञियासः पञ्च जना मम होत्रं जुषध्वम्
paragraphs.translit: ūrjāda uta yajñiyāsaḥ pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣadhvam

paragraphs.text: 5. May the Five Tribes be pleased with mine oblation, and the Cow's Sons and all who merit worship.
paragraphs.original: पञ्च जना मम होत्रं जुषन्तां गोजाता उत ये यज्ञियासः ।
paragraphs.translit: pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣantāṃ gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ |

paragraphs.text: From earthly trouble may the earth protect us, and air's mid realm from woe that comes from heaven.
paragraphs.original: पृथिवी नः पार्थिवात्पात्वंहसोऽन्तरिक्षं दिव्यात्पात्वस्मान्
paragraphs.translit: pṛthivī naḥ pārthivātpātvaṃhaso'ntarikṣaṃ divyātpātvasmān

paragraphs.text: 6. Spinning the thread, follow the region's splendid light: guard thou the path ways well which wisdom hath prepared.
paragraphs.original: तन्तुं तन्वन्रजसो भानुमन्विहि ज्योतिष्मतः पथो रक्ष धिया कृतान् ।
paragraphs.translit: tantuṃ tanvanrajaso bhānumanvihi jyotiṣmataḥ patho rakṣa dhiyā kṛtān |

paragraphs.text: Weave ye the knotless labour of the bards who sing: be Manu thou, and bring the Heavenly People forth.
paragraphs.original: अनुल्बणं वयत जोगुवामपो मनुर्भव जनया दैव्यं जनम्
paragraphs.translit: anulbaṇaṃ vayata joguvāmapo manurbhava janayā daivyaṃ janam

paragraphs.text: 7. Lovers of Soma, bind the chariot traces fast: set ye the reins in order and embellish them.
paragraphs.original: अक्षानहो नह्यतनोत सोम्या इष्कृणुध्वं रशना ओत पिंशत ।
paragraphs.translit: akṣānaho nahyatanota somyā iṣkṛṇudhvaṃ raśanā ota piṃśata |

paragraphs.text: Bring hitherward the car with seats where eight may sit, whereon the Gods have brought the treasure that we love.
paragraphs.original: अष्टावन्धुरं वहताभितो रथं येन देवासो अनयन्नभि प्रियम्
paragraphs.translit: aṣṭāvandhuraṃ vahatābhito rathaṃ yena devāso anayannabhi priyam

paragraphs.text: 8. Here flows Asmanvati: hold fast each other, keep yourselves up, and pass, my friends, the river.
paragraphs.original: अश्मन्वती रीयते सं रभध्वमुत्तिष्ठत प्र तरता सखायः ।
paragraphs.translit: aśmanvatī rīyate saṃ rabhadhvamuttiṣṭhata pra taratā sakhāyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: There let us leave the Powers that brought no profit, and cross the flood to Powers that are auspicious.
paragraphs.original: अत्रा जहाम ये असन्नशेवाः शिवान्वयमुत्तरेमाभि वाजान्
paragraphs.translit: atrā jahāma ye asannaśevāḥ śivānvayamuttaremābhi vājān

paragraphs.text: 9. Tvastar, most deft of workmen, knew each magic art, bringing most blessed bowls that hold the drink of Gods.
paragraphs.original: त्वष्टा माया वेदपसामपस्तमो बिभ्रत्पात्रा देवपानानि शंतमा ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṣṭā māyā vedapasāmapastamo bibhratpātrā devapānāni śaṃtamā |

paragraphs.text: His axe, wrought of good metal, he is sharpening now, wherewith the radiant Brahmanaspati will cut.
paragraphs.original: शिशीते नूनं परशुं स्वायसं येन वृश्चादेतशो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः
paragraphs.translit: śiśīte nūnaṃ paraśuṃ svāyasaṃ yena vṛścādetaśo brahmaṇaspatiḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. Now, O ye Sapient Ones, make ye the axes sharp wherewith ye fashion bowls to hold the Amrta.
paragraphs.original: सतो नूनं कवयः सं शिशीत वाशीभिर्याभिरमृताय तक्षथ ।
paragraphs.translit: sato nūnaṃ kavayaḥ saṃ śiśīta vāśībhiryābhiramṛtāya takṣatha |

paragraphs.text: Knowing the secret places make ye ready that whereby the Gods have gotten immortality.
paragraphs.original: विद्वांसः पदा गुह्यानि कर्तन येन देवासो अमृतत्वमानशुः
paragraphs.translit: vidvāṃsaḥ padā guhyāni kartana yena devāso amṛtatvamānaśuḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. Ye with a secret tongue and dark intention laid the maiden deep within, the calf within the mouth.
paragraphs.original: गर्भे योषामदधुर्वत्समासन्यपीच्येन मनसोत जिह्वया ।
paragraphs.translit: garbhe yoṣāmadadhurvatsamāsanyapīcyena manasota jihvayā |

paragraphs.text: They evermore are near us with their gracious help: successful is the song that strives for victory.
paragraphs.original: स विश्वाहा सुमना योग्या अभि सिषासनिर्वनते कार इज्जितिम्
paragraphs.translit: sa viśvāhā sumanā yogyā abhi siṣāsanirvanate kāra ijjitim
